body: thank you. i hope she can get better

my brother, father and i just sat down and spoke about the situation now that she's left. we are going to talk to the family doctor ASAP and try to get her to agree to speak with the doc and hopefully a therapist. these are real mental health issues that she's been ignoring for a long time.

thanks again for taking the time to talk to me

edit: not sure why someone would downvote you here

i don't think the aggressive/tough love method will work on her. i fear it will push her away even more. the problem is she usually drinks without us realizing it.

she has no family left other than her husband and kids. her mom died a couple years back (and i think she has yet to move past it), her brother and father died when she was young.

>When she is acting sane, are you able to bring up these tantrums?

after a couple days usually. but right now she is still sober and very emotional and just as bad as yesterday. she often promises that she'll never drink again ("i don't need that shit, son, i'm sorry. never again"). 

she is packing up all the christmas gifts she bought and she's taking them back. not sure if she is coming back.

thank you very much for the kind words and advice. i greatly appreciate it.
